title: Create
contentPostSubtitle: Share a photo, video, or quick food moment.
reviewSubtitle: Rate the restaurant and the dishes you tried.
selectContentMediaTitle: Start with your best food moment
selectContentMediaHint: Choose photos from your library, take a new photo, or add one short video.
contentMediaRules: Up to 10 photos or one video up to 10 seconds
cameraPermissionBody: Allow camera access to capture a quick post, or choose a photo from your gallery.
cameraPermissionDeniedBody: Turn on camera access in Settings to take photos, or continue with one from your gallery.
cameraPrivacy: FindEat only uses the camera when you choose to take a photo.
takePhotoOrChooseGallery: Take a photo or choose from gallery
chooseReviewCoverSourceBody: Take a new photo or choose one from your gallery.
emptyContentBody: Food moments from people you follow will appear here. You can start the feed with your own.
contentEmptyHint: Capture a photo, tag the place, and post.
emptyReviewsBody: Detailed restaurant and dish reviews from the community will appear here.
reviewEmptyHint: Share where you ate and what you thought.
finishQuickPostBody: Tag the place, add a note if you want, then preview it.
addDescriptionBody: This is optional. You can keep it short or leave it empty.
chooseRestaurantBody: Every quick post must be connected to a place.
searchRestaurantPrompt: Search for the restaurant in your photo.
noRestaurantsFound: No restaurants found. Try another search.
leavePostBody: You can keep it as a draft or discard your changes.
addFullReviewBody: Help people decide where to eat. Rate dishes, service, and atmosphere.
continueFullReviewHint: Your review details are saved here until you finish or post without them.
visibilityPUBLICHint: Everyone can see it. Public reviews affect restaurant and dish ratings.
visibilityFRIENDSHint: Only people you follow who also follow you can see it. It will not affect public ratings.
visibilityPRIVATEHint: This stays in your private food diary and will not affect public ratings.
nearbyUnavailable: Allow location access to see the nearest places, or search by name.
noNearbyPlaces: No nearby places were found. Try searching by name.
reviewEverythingOptional: Add only what you want to share. The photo, ratings, and written notes are all optional.
reviewBuildHint: Build your review your way. Tap any detail to add or edit it.
reviewNoteEditorHint: Share what stood out, what you loved, or what other diners should know.
tapAnotherRating: Tap another number to change it
occasionEditorHint: Choose the option that best describes this visit.
visitDateEditorHint: Adding the date gives your review useful context.
experienceTagsEditorHint: Select everything that was true during your visit.
totalPriceEditorHint: Optionally add the total bill for the visit.
placePhotoHint: Show the restaurant itself—its storefront, atmosphere, seating, or interior. Dish photos are added separately next.
addPlacePhoto: Add a photo of the place
reviewNotePlaceholder: What stood out? Leave this empty if you prefer.
visitContextHint: Optional context helps other people choose the right place—and helps restaurants earn trusted community badges.
dishPhotoFirstHint: Start with a dish photo if you have one. If you skip it, FindEat will use the official menu photo when available.
buildDishHint: Tap any detail to add or edit it. Only the dish name is required for a custom dish.
dishNameEditorHint: Give the dish the name people would recognize on the menu.
dishPriceEditorHint: Add the price you paid for this dish. You can leave it empty.
dishRatingEditorHint: How would you rate this dish?
dishNoteEditorHint: Describe the taste, texture, portion, or anything diners should know.
yourDishPhotoSelected: Your photo will replace the menu photo in this review.
usingMenuDishPhoto: No upload needed—the official menu photo will be used.
menuDishPhotoFallbackHint: Skip the upload and the official menu photo will be used when you add the dish.
dishNotePlaceholder: What did you think about this dish?
validPriceRequired: Enter a price greater than zero.
connectReviewHint: Optional — choose your review or a collaborative review you joined for this restaurant.
connectContentHint: Optional — attach a photo or video you already shared about this visit.
addReviewPromptBody: Your quick post is live. You can now add a written review and connect the two automatically.
postAndAddReviewHint: We’ll reuse this restaurant and connect both posts.
contentDraftFoundBody: You have an unfinished quick post. Continue where you left off or discard it and start again.
reviewDraftFoundBody: You have an unfinished review. Continue where you left off or discard it and start again.
deleteDraftBody: This post draft and its selected media will be permanently removed.
exitReviewBody: Save your progress as a draft, or discard it and leave.
addContentPromptBody: Add a quick photo post from this visit. It will connect to your review automatically.
reviewRestaurantSubtitle: Start by choosing the place you want to review.
dishesStepSubtitle: Add dishes if you want to rate them individually, or skip this step.
menuDishPickerHint: Find it quickly from this restaurant’s menu
addCustomDishHint: Add its name yourself if it is not on the menu
addCustomDishPrompt: Can’t find it? Add a custom dish
noDishesReviewHint: This is optional. You can continue with only the restaurant review.
tryAnotherDishSearch: Try another search or add this dish yourself.
addDishManuallyHint: You can still add and review the dish manually.
reviewPreviewSubtitle: Check your review before publishing it.
reviewPublishErrorBody: Could not publish the review. Please try again.
farRestaurantBody: This media appears to have been captured far away from the selected restaurant.
reviewTogetherRowHint: Invite friends to add their own take
reviewTogetherFriendsOnly: Only friends can be invited to a shared review.
noSuggestedFriends: Friends you can invite will appear here.
privateReviewTogetherBody: A private review is visible only to you. Making it private will remove the people you selected.
reviewInvitesAfterPublish_one: Your friend will be invited after you publish.
reviewInvitesAfterPublish_other: {{count}} friends will be invited after you publish.
tagPeopleRowHint: Show who you were with in this quick post
tagPeopleFriendsOnly: Only friends can be tagged in a quick post.
privateTagPeopleBody: A private post is visible only to you. Making it private will remove the people you selected.
chooseContentMediaBody: Take a photo or choose media from your library.
muteOriginalSoundHint: Turn this off to publish the video without its recorded audio.
videoEditHint: Tap the video to play or pause
editPhotoHint: Tap to select · hold and drag to reorder
imageEditError: Could not edit this photo. Please try again.
addPhotosBody: Choose where your next photo should come from.
videoTooLongBody: Choose a video that is 10 seconds or shorter.
videoPickerErrorBody: Please choose another short video and try again.
videoRecordingErrorBody: The camera could not record this video. Photo mode has been restored—please try again.
microphonePermissionBody: FindEat needs microphone access only while recording a video with sound.
leaveReviewBody: Keep what you filled in for later, or discard the review details and return to your post.
unfinishedReviewBody: Would you like to finish the review, or post only the content and discard those review details?
